items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: And they had some guy around in New Orleans. His name was Joe Mapu.

ctx.x: You want a little Coke? You want Coke? You want a drink there? Well, let's change it. I'll have

the drink there. All right. You can change it. Yeah, give me a little liquor and a glass and put some ice in my hand. That's good. Used to be a joint in New Orleans. Yeah. Used to sell wine a long time ago. And had these big tall glasses, but they'd fill these glasses with the crushed ice. First and then they'd pour the wine in there. Yeah. And they had some guy around in New Orleans. His name was Joe Mapu. Yeah. And Joe Mapu was supposed to be kind of dumb. But he used to come in the place one day and he says,…
